title: A food tour that’s actually worth the money!
text:
I did this food walk around the Gothic Quarter and El Born in with my friends and honestly it was way better than I expected.

We stopped at a bunch of places with really amazing food and drinks! proper traditional Catalan stuff, not the usual touristy things you see everywhere. Everything was super tasty and there was more than enough, I definitely left full.

The guide was also a big highlight. Really funny, easygoing, and somehow managed to make all the history actually interesting. I’ve lived in Barcelona for 4 years and still learned loads of things about the area that I had no idea about

title: A perfect mix of food, history and fun!
text: Had an amazing time on this tour and would definitely recommend it to anyone visiting Barcelona. The food was excellent throughout the whole experience, but what really made the tour stand out was the guide. He was genuinely fun and kept the energy and atmosphere great the entire time, while still being very knowledgeable and professional. It never felt forced or overly touristy. It was more like exploring the city with someone who truly loves Barcelona and knows all the hidden gems. A perfect mix of great food, interesting history, and good vibes.

title: Great Barcelona Tour
text: Amazing service! I wanted to try a Barcelona tour with my local friend, and we both really enjoyed it. Our tour guide, who was from Barcelona, made the experience even better with so many interesting stories and insights about the city. Everything felt authentic, engaging, and fun to learn about. On top of that, the group was very diverse, which made the whole experience even more enriching and enjoyable. Definitely a great recommendation, and I’d happily do another tour with them in the future!
author: marcbE1018IB

title: Must do tour in Barcelona!!!
text:
One of the best experiences we had in Barcelona. The tour was the perfect mix of amazing food, local history, and hidden spots around the Gothic Quarter and El Born.

Our guide was fantastic, very knowledgeable, friendly, and passionate about the city and its culture. The food was excellent at every stop, and we discovered places we never would have found on our own.

What made this tour special was how authentic and personal it felt. It never felt rushed or touristy. If you want a real taste of Barcelona, this tour is absolutely worth it. Highly recommended.
